title: Louis Braille
content:
When Louis Braille was three years old, he fell in his father’s workroom which left him blind. But despite blindness, he could play several musical instruments. Unfortunately, he couldn't read or write. At the age of ten, he won a scholarship to the National Institute for blind children in Paris.

In 1826, Braille began teaching the blind in the institute. In 1819, a French soldier, Charles Barbier invented “Point Writing” system. He used special dots on paper so that soldiers could read at night. Louis Braille heard people speaking about this system. He quickly understood that such system would be of great help for blind people. So, he began to develop it. In 1829, he started to use it at the institute.

Now, all over the world blind people can read textbooks thanks to what's known as “Braille System”. Louis Braille died in 1852. He never knew the importance of his invention.
translation_ar:
عندما كان لويس برايل في الثالثة من عمره، سقط في ورشة عمل والده مما أدى إلى إصابته بالعمى. وعلى الرغم من فقدانه للبصر، كان يستطيع العزف على عدة آلات موسيقية. لكنه، للأسف، لم يكن يستطيع القراءة أو الكتابة. في سن العاشرة، حصل على منحة دراسية للالتحاق بالمعهد الوطني للأطفال المكفوفين في باريس.

في عام 1826، بدأ برايل بتعليم المكفوفين في المعهد. وفي عام 1819، اخترع جندي فرنسي يُدعى شارل باربييه نظام الكتابة بالنقاط. استخدم نقاطًا خاصة على الورق حتى يتمكن الجنود من القراءة ليلًا. سمع لويس برايل الناس يتحدثون عن هذا النظام، وفهم بسرعة أن مثل هذا النظام سيكون مفيدًا جدًا للمكفوفين. لذلك بدأ في تطويره، وفي عام 1829 بدأ استخدامه في المعهد.

اليوم، يستطيع المكفوفون في جميع أنحاء العالم قراءة الكتب المدرسية بفضل ما يُعرف بنظام برايل. توفي لويس برايل عام 1852، ولم يعرف أبدًا مدى أهمية اختراعه.

title: My Eating Habits
content:
I'm not really a healthy eater but I try to do my best. I eat two or more pieces of fruit every day and I have some vegetables, two portions a day. I prefer lean meat like chicken and fish.

However, I sometimes go to the fast food restaurant where I order burgers or pizzas and sodas. I know they are high fat products but they are tasty and I like them.

I have to make some changes to my diet and eat less calories. So I drink a lot of milk and I usually have some yoghurt and cheese. I promise I will not buy pastries; these are often made with butter, sugar, cream and eggs.

ومع ذلك، أذهب أحيانًا إلى مطعم للوجبات السريعة حيث أطلب البرغر أو البيتزا والمشروبات الغازية. أعرف أنها أطعمة غنية بالدهون، لكنها لذيذة وأنا أحبها.

يجب أن أجري بعض التغييرات على نظامي الغذائي وأن أتناول سعرات حرارية أقل. لذلك أشرب الكثير من الحليب، وعادة ما أتناول بعض اللبن والجبن. وأعد بأنني لن أشتري المعجنات؛ فهي غالبًا ما تُصنع من الزبدة والسكر والقشدة والبيض.

title: Beethoven
content:
Beethoven, one of the greatest composers and whose music is played all over the world, was deaf. It's difficult to believe that he couldn't hear for most of his life as a composer.

Beethoven was only 26 when he started to become deaf. When he was 30, he had noises in his ears. He had to play his piano very loudly to hear the music. Over the next few years, he quickly became deafer and deafer. At first, he could use an ear trumpet to help him hear, but soon it made no difference. Finally, he had to use “conversation books” to communicate with people by writing. He was able to write a personal diary of how being deaf made him sad and lonely.

But Beethoven was also a very cheerful person who was able to conduct the first performance of his “Ninth Symphony” in 1824. He couldn't hear when the orchestra stopped playing at the end and he couldn't hear the audience's applause.
translation_ar:
كان بيتهوفن، أحد أعظم المؤلفين الموسيقيين الذين تُعزف موسيقاهم في جميع أنحاء العالم، أصمًا. ومن الصعب تصديق أنه لم يكن يستطيع السماع طوال معظم حياته كمؤلف موسيقي.

كان بيتهوفن في السادسة والعشرين فقط عندما بدأ يفقد سمعه. وعندما بلغ الثلاثين، كان يعاني من أصوات في أذنيه. وكان عليه أن يعزف على البيانو بصوت عالٍ جدًا حتى يسمع الموسيقى. وخلال السنوات التالية، أصبح أكثر فأكثر فقدانًا للسمع. في البداية، كان يستطيع استخدام بوق للأذن لمساعدته على السماع، لكنه سرعان ما أصبح بلا فائدة. وأخيرًا، اضطر إلى استخدام دفاتر المحادثة للتواصل مع الناس عن طريق الكتابة. وتمكن من كتابة مذكرات شخصية عن مدى شعوره بالحزن والوحدة بسبب فقدان السمع.

لكن بيتهوفن كان أيضًا شخصًا مرحًا جدًا، وتمكن من قيادة العرض الأول للسمفونية التاسعة عام 1824. ولم يكن يستطيع سماع توقف الأوركسترا عن العزف في النهاية، كما لم يكن يستطيع سماع تصفيق الجمهور.

title: A Complaint About a Restaurant
content:
Dear Sir,

I am writing to draw your attention to the awful situation of your restaurant. It's worsening; the prices are expensive, food and dishes are common and the waiters are rude and inappropriate.

My wife and I have been to your restaurant last week, to celebrate our wedding anniversary. It was a big mess. The waiters were rude; we waited for more than half an hour to get our orders. The soup was cold and salty. They used frozen meat and canned vegetables. We couldn't eat it. It was horrible! I checked the menu once again to change, but nothing interesting. The menu was very poor and limited. So, we ordered some French fries, salad and some grilled food just to save our dinner. I tried to manage but unfortunately, we were very embarrassed and dissatisfied.

Later on, the waiter brought us the bill which was really shocking. It was very exaggerated. The prices were more expensive than usual and unjustified. Why pay so much for a poor menu, horrible food and very bad service? It was a disastrous dinner.

I would like you to improve your service and try to review your prices. Ask the waiters to be more appropriate and tolerant with the customers; they should change their attitude. Also, the chef must check and review the menu and recipes; he must use fresh vegetables and meat. Sir, I am a regular customer and I hope your restaurant will get its fame and allure soon again.

Respectfully,
Mr. Paul Reynold
translation_ar:
سيدي المحترم،

أكتب إليكم لألفت انتباهكم إلى الوضع السيئ لمطعمكم. إن الوضع يزداد سوءًا؛ فالأسعار مرتفعة، والطعام والأطباق عادية، والنادلون فظون وغير لائقين.

لقد ذهبت أنا وزوجتي إلى مطعمكم الأسبوع الماضي للاحتفال بذكرى زواجنا. كانت تجربة سيئة للغاية. كان النادلون فظين، وانتظرنا أكثر من نصف ساعة للحصول على طلباتنا. كان الحساء باردًا ومالحًا. لقد استخدموا لحمًا مجمدًا وخضروات معلبة. لم نستطع تناوله. كان فظيعًا! ألقيت نظرة على قائمة الطعام مرة أخرى لأغير طلبي، لكن لم يكن هناك شيء مثير للاهتمام. كانت القائمة فقيرة ومحدودة جدًا. لذلك طلبنا بعض البطاطا المقلية والسلطة وبعض الطعام المشوي لإنقاذ عشاءنا.

لاحقًا، أحضر لنا النادل الفاتورة وكانت صادمة حقًا. كانت مبالغًا فيها جدًا. كانت الأسعار أغلى من المعتاد وغير مبررة. لماذا ندفع كل هذا مقابل قائمة طعام فقيرة وطعام سيئ وخدمة سيئة جدًا؟ لقد كان عشاءً كارثيًا.

أود منكم تحسين خدمتكم ومراجعة أسعاركم. اطلبوا من النادلين أن يكونوا أكثر لياقة وتسامحًا مع الزبائن؛ عليهم تغيير سلوكهم. كما يجب على الطاهي مراجعة قائمة الطعام والوصفات واستخدام الخضروات واللحوم الطازجة. سيدي، أنا زبون دائم وأتمنى أن يستعيد مطعمكم شهرته وجاذبيته قريبًا.

مع خالص الاحترام،
السيد بول رينولد

title: An Apology for Missing a Party
content:
Dear Jack,

Sorry I was not able to attend your party last Sunday. I was quite ready to come and just about to leave when a friend of mine from Algeria, on her way to America, dropped in. She wanted to spend the night at home. The next morning, she left. This was why I couldn't come, could I?

Of course, I tried to call, but I couldn't get through. Your number was engaged. I hope you will understand. I know you needed my CD player, but I am sure you all had a good time.

Love,
Jill

بالطبع، حاولت الاتصال بك، لكنني لم أتمكن من الوصول إليك. كان رقمك مشغولًا. أتمنى أن تتفهم الأمر. أعرف أنك كنت بحاجة إلى مشغل الأقراص المدمجة الخاص بي، لكنني متأكدة من أنكم قضيتم وقتًا ممتعًا.

title: Takeaways in Britain
content:
On weekdays, British people are busy working all day long. They don't have time to prepare their meals at home. They buy “takeaways”. What's a “takeaway”?

It's a quick meal we get in a restaurant but we take it home to eat. The English “takeaway” is a speciality of fish and chips. It's a kind of fried fish served with chips. We find takeaway restaurants everywhere in Great Britain, like the “Jack's Fish and Chips Corner” restaurant. They are typical of British life.

On weekends, eating a “Sunday lunch” is a tradition in British families. The main dishes are roast beef and the delicious Yorkshire pudding. But the pudding is not a cake and it isn't served as a dessert. It's a kind of salted pie.

إنها وجبة سريعة نحصل عليها من مطعم ونأخذها إلى المنزل لتناولها. الوجبة الجاهزة الإنجليزية تشتهر بالسمك ورقائق البطاطا. وهي نوع من السمك المقلي يقدم مع البطاطا المقلية. نجد مطاعم الوجبات الجاهزة في كل مكان في بريطانيا العظمى، مثل مطعم «ركن جاك للسمك والبطاطا». وهي جزء مميز من الحياة البريطانية.

في عطلات نهاية الأسبوع، يعد تناول غداء الأحد تقليدًا في العائلات البريطانية. الأطباق الرئيسية هي اللحم البقري المشوي وحلوى يوركشاير اللذيذة. لكن حلوى يوركشاير ليست كعكة ولا تقدم كحلوى بعد الطعام، بل هي نوع من الفطيرة المالحة.

title: Computer
content:
Computer is a new automatic and electronic machine that is used to help people in their work. Van Newman invented it in 1948.

It is one of the most important inventions of this century. It has a screen, a keyboard, a mouse, a headphone, etc. It contains five parts: input, memory, arithmetic and logic, control and output.

A computer can write, play games, perform music and make drawings, etc. It can store and give information very quickly; it is able to do the work of hundreds of workers in a very short time.

Nowadays, computers are used in different places: schools, universities, factories, hospitals and other public services and even at home. They make our life easier and better.

وهو أحد أهم اختراعات هذا القرن. يحتوي على شاشة ولوحة مفاتيح وفأرة وسماعات وغيرها. ويتكون من خمسة أجزاء: الإدخال، والذاكرة، والحساب والمنطق، والتحكم، والإخراج.

يمكن للحاسوب الكتابة وتشغيل الألعاب وتشغيل الموسيقى وإنجاز الرسومات وغيرها. كما يستطيع تخزين المعلومات وتقديمها بسرعة كبيرة، ويمكنه القيام بعمل مئات العمال في وقت قصير جدًا.

title: Don't Be Fat
content:
Teenagers are getting fat. A new study says that most teenagers are too fat. Is that true? Look at the people around you. Are most of them fat? Are most of them thin? Or are most of them in between? Many fat people get sick. They die young.

Doctors say these people can live longer. They must eat more fruits and vegetables. They must eat less meat. They must eat more fish. They must eat less fried food. They must not eat at fast food restaurants. No more cheeseburgers and no more French fries. They must eat less bread and less pasta. If they eat less, they will weigh less.

But teenagers must also exercise. They must walk more. They don't have to run or jog. They don't have to climb stairs. All they have to do is walk. Just walk 30 minutes a day. Is that hard to do? Eat less. Walk more. Live longer. It sounds easy. But people love to eat. Eating is fun. Food is delicious. So it's not easy to eat less. Try to do it. It's hard to do.
translation_ar:
يزداد وزن المراهقين. تقول دراسة جديدة إن معظم المراهقين يعانون من زيادة الوزن. هل هذا صحيح؟ انظر إلى الأشخاص من حولك. هل معظمهم سمينون؟ هل معظمهم نحيفون؟ أم أن معظمهم بين الحالتين؟ كثير من الأشخاص الذين يعانون من السمنة يمرضون ويموتون في سن مبكرة.

يقول الأطباء إن هؤلاء الأشخاص يمكنهم أن يعيشوا مدة أطول. يجب عليهم تناول المزيد من الفواكه والخضروات، وتقليل تناول اللحوم، وتناول المزيد من السمك، وتقليل الأطعمة المقلية. يجب ألا يأكلوا في مطاعم الوجبات السريعة. لا مزيد من البرغر بالجبن ولا مزيد من البطاطا المقلية. يجب عليهم تناول كمية أقل من الخبز والمعكرونة. إذا أكلوا أقل، فسيصبح وزنهم أقل.

لكن يجب على المراهقين أيضًا ممارسة الرياضة. عليهم المشي أكثر. لا يتعين عليهم الركض أو الجري، ولا يتعين عليهم صعود السلالم. كل ما عليهم فعله هو المشي لمدة 30 دقيقة يوميًا. هل هذا صعب؟ كل أقل، وامشِ أكثر، وعش مدة أطول. يبدو الأمر سهلًا، لكن الناس يحبون الأكل. الأكل ممتع والطعام لذيذ، لذلك ليس من السهل تناول كمية أقل. حاول أن تفعل ذلك، فالأمر صعب.

title: Eating Out
content:
“Claude's Kitchen” isn't very large, but the food is good. Claude Boulet does the cooking, and the menu includes a lot of New Orleans French favourites. When I was there, I had a tasty mixture of steak and fish cooked in a heavy pot. I thought it was delicious.

“Claude's Kitchen”, located at 311 Bourbon Street, is open for dinner every evening until 10:00, Tuesday to Sunday.

The restaurant gets very busy, so be sure to make a reservation before you go.

title: The Importance of Food on Health
content: The type of food we eat has a direct influence on our health. If it is a poor quality, it does not offer the necessary nutrients for the body to become strong and developed. The chemical changes and the vital processes which take place inside the organism need the presence of essential substances like proteins, vitamins and mineral salts. Without them, the organic tissues do not get constructed, the blood system gets seriously affected while the bones lose their strength and the nervous system finds itself unable to coordinate the biological functions of the organs. In addition to the substances referred to above the human body requires a regular intake of fats and carbohydrates. These ones constitute a major source of energy thanks to which we are able to perform the physical tasks we do every day.

title: Never Give Up
content: Dear Ali, I know you are angry because of your bad marks. I think you shouldn't lose faith and always keep on working hard to improve your results. Let me tell you the story of a man who failed in school but didn't give up. It's Donald Trump. His father always describes him as a naughty boy. He left school at the age of 13 and joined the New York Military Academy, but he was able to study high school there and graduate with a degree. He was able to study and work at the same time. He became a very famous businessman. He wanted to be the president of America many times and at last, he was able to win the presidency. Now, at the age of 70, he can enjoy and live his dream becoming true. I think that what matters is not failing but trying over until we get what we are looking for. Yours, Jonathan.

title: YouTube
content: YouTube is a popular video sharing website that allows users to watch videos posted by others and upload videos of their own. It was developed by former PayPal employees Chad Hurley, Steve Chen, and Jawed Karim. The service was started as an independent website in 2005 and was acquired by Google in 2006. Users can search for and watch videos, create a personal YouTube channel. They can also subscribe and follow other channels. Therefore, there is a wide range of videos available on YouTube. Some examples include homemade music videos, sports bloopers, and other funny events caught on video. People also use YouTube to post instructional videos, such as step-by-step computer help, do-it-yourself guides and other how-to videos. Before YouTube existed, we could learn about countries and cultures by reading books and articles online, watching documentaries and looking at published pictures. But YouTube allows us to take things a step further and learn about places and cultures around the world from the actual people who live there. It has also changed the face of entertainment. We used to watch television, go to the movies, read books. Today, we can spend hours watching videos all from home for free. YouTube has had a profound impact on media and advertising.

title: Healthy Eating
content: If you want to live longer, you should learn to live healthy, therefore, to eat sane food. By sane, I mean how healthy a food is for us; it is the way we can choose foods based on their quality. Eating sane foods will help our hormones and metabolism to heal, allowing our body to give up any excess of fat. Sane foods give us energy and make us feel fantastic! Sane foods are foods that are satisfying, unaggressive and nutritious. Sane lifestyle focuses on eating foods that are high in water, fiber, protein and avoiding processed meats, margarine, soda, sugars and other sweeteners.

title: Healthy Food
content: Healthy food is good for you. You need it for shiny hair and strong bones. You need it so you can grow tall and feel good. The best part about healthy food is that it is tasty! You can find grains in bread, rice, and oatmeal. You should eat four servings of grains every day. Milk, cheese, and yogurt are also important. These will give you strong bones. Meat, beans, fish, and nuts give your body iron and protein. You can also eat an egg or some peanut butter to help keep your body healthy. Fruit and vegetables are good to eat. Eat many kinds each week. Chips and cookies are tasty, but eat only a few at a time. When you eat healthy food, your body will thank you!

title: A Letter from Nature
content: Dear Friend, When I was young, I started my day on the East so I could welcome the warm sunrise. The air was cool and smelled so fresh. The flowers were blooming with colours and the butterflies were flying freely in the Babylonian gardens. The sky was so blue and the birds glided gracefully with their sweet songs. The rivers were clear as a mirror and fish swam under the beauty of the Pacific Sea. When the moon and the sun set above the ocean, the water twinkled like a diamond star. These were the memories of my past that I miss so hard. Time has faded my beauty and others abused my generosity. I gave shelter to humans and nurtured wildlife. I gave you food, clothing and medicine, but you gave me nothing. The billions of years that I took care of your generation have led to my destruction. I gave you everything, my friend, but again, you gave me nothing. I am writing to you today to say that I love you, my dear friend. I want to share with you everything and all that is left of what I have so you can live happily with your family. I am willing to sacrifice my life for your survival because I care for you. Just like you, my friend, I will soon grow old and die. The time of my death is still unknown, but to be honest, I am scared to die. I am scared not to see your children grow and I will be hurt to leave this world. Do you really love me, my friend? Then why don't you take care of me?

title: The History of Chocolate
content: People from all over the world like the taste of chocolate. Chocolate is a food that many people enjoy as a dessert or snack. Some people like dark chocolate and some people like light chocolate. Some people like plain chocolate and others like nuts or cream inside. Maybe you have heard about Hershey, Pennsylvania. There, Milton Hershey first made chocolate. The name Hershey is known throughout the world. Milton Hershey died in 1945, but the chocolate factory and Hershey's chocolate continues to be made in Hershey, Pennsylvania. First, he learned to make caramels. When he was 29 years old, he started a caramel business, and in four years his business was very successful and he opened a chocolate factory. The Hershey Chocolate Company grew to make sweet chocolate and cocoa. Hershey died but the world remembers him for not only making chocolate bars, but for his work to help people, especially his workers, through his foundation. He is remembered as someone who built an entire city and helped people get jobs. He is remembered as someone who made a school for children who did not have families. He also made a medical centre to help those who were sick and made the chocolate which most of us throughout the world enjoy.

title: The Future of Space Travel
content: Today, people can do many things they couldn't do years ago. For example, people can drive cars, take photographs, forecast the weather and do many other exceptional things. They can even fly across the ocean and go to the moon in spaceships without any difficulty. However, man's present ability to fly is the result of past achievements by exceptional pilots like the Wright Brothers who were able to fly the first plane in 1903 and Charles Lindbergh who was able to make the first solo nonstop flight in 1927. In the near future, man will certainly be able to go to space by a new type of spaceship in which the future astronauts will be a new generation of robots. These robots may go on missions of exploration to the different planets which won't be a secret.
translation_ar: اليوم يستطيع الناس القيام بالعديد من الأشياء التي لم يكونوا قادرين على القيام بها في الماضي. فعلى سبيل المثال، يمكنهم قيادة السيارات والتقاط الصور والتنبؤ بالطقس والقيام بالعديد من الأشياء الاستثنائية الأخرى. كما يمكنهم الطيران فوق المحيط والوصول إلى القمر بواسطة المركبات الفضائية. ومع ذلك، فإن قدرة الإنسان الحالية على الطيران هي نتيجة لإنجازات سابقة قام بها طيارون استثنائيون مثل الأخوين رايت، اللذين تمكنا من قيادة أول طائرة عام 1903، وتشارلز ليندبيرغ الذي تمكن من القيام بأول رحلة جوية فردية دون توقف عام 1927. وفي المستقبل القريب، سيتمكن الإنسان بالتأكيد من الذهاب إلى الفضاء بواسطة نوع جديد من المركبات الفضائية، حيث سيكون رواد الفضاء المستقبليون جيلاً جديداً من الروبوتات. وقد تذهب هذه الروبوتات في بعثات استكشافية إلى الكواكب المختلفة التي لن تبقى مجهولة.

title: Julia Jefferson
content: Julia Jefferson is Canadian. She is 16 years old. She is a student at Brighton Comprehensive. She is a very good student. She can speak three languages well: English, French and Spanish. She is also very good at sports. She can swim and dive. She could swim from her childhood. She's an excellent diver; in fact, she's Canada's Diving Champion. Julia's family is big. She has got two brothers and a sister. Her sister's name is Rachel. Rachel is 7 years old. She can play tennis very well. Rachel has got a new racket. It is green and yellow. She loves it! Who knows, maybe in the future, Rachel will be able to take part in international tennis competitions and she may be a new Canadian Tennis Champion.
translation_ar: جوليا جيفرسون كندية، تبلغ من العمر 16 عاماً، وهي تلميذة في مدرسة برايتون الشاملة. إنها تلميذة جيدة جداً. تستطيع التحدث بثلاث لغات بشكل جيد: الإنجليزية والفرنسية والإسبانية. كما أنها جيدة جداً في الرياضة. تستطيع السباحة والغوص، وكانت قادرة على السباحة منذ طفولتها. إنها غواصة ممتازة، وفي الواقع هي بطلة كندا في الغوص. عائلة جوليا كبيرة. لديها شقيقان وأخت واحدة. اسم أختها راشيل. راشيل تبلغ من العمر 7 سنوات. تستطيع لعب التنس بشكل جيد جداً. لديها مضرب جديد لونه أخضر وأصفر، وهي تحبه كثيراً! من يدري، ربما ستتمكن راشيل في المستقبل من المشاركة في مسابقات التنس الدولية، وقد تصبح بطلة كندا الجديدة في التنس.

title: What I Can Do Now
content: When I was a baby I couldn't talk, but I could sleep 12 hours a day. Before I went to school I couldn't read nor write, but I was able to speak English. When I visited Barcelona I couldn't understand what people were saying, because I couldn't speak Spanish then. In kindergarten I couldn't add 2 + 2, but now I can do multiplication and division. When I was 3 years old I couldn't ride a bike, but now I can ride a bike and a horse! When I went to camp for the first time I couldn't sail a boat. I will be able to sail 10-meter boats. In the beginning of first grade I couldn't write Greek or English, but now I can write in both languages. At the age of 5 years, I couldn't manipulate a computer, now that I am 7, I can use a computer and an iPhone. When I was young I couldn't play football, but now I can score lots of goals. In my second level grade I couldn't swim very well, but now I can swim long distances.
translation_ar: عندما كنت رضيعاً لم أكن أستطيع الكلام، لكنني كنت أستطيع النوم 12 ساعة في اليوم. قبل أن أذهب إلى المدرسة، لم أكن أستطيع القراءة أو الكتابة، لكنني كنت قادراً على التحدث باللغة الإنجليزية. عندما زرت برشلونة، لم أكن أفهم ما يقوله الناس لأنني لم أكن أستطيع التحدث بالإسبانية حينها. في روضة الأطفال، لم أكن أستطيع حساب 2 + 2، لكنني الآن أستطيع القيام بعمليات الضرب والقسمة. عندما كان عمري 3 سنوات، لم أكن أستطيع ركوب الدراجة، لكنني الآن أستطيع ركوب الدراجة والحصان! عندما ذهبت إلى المخيم للمرة الأولى، لم أكن أستطيع قيادة قارب، لكنني سأتمكن من قيادة قوارب طولها 10 أمتار. في بداية الصف الأول، لم أكن أستطيع الكتابة باليونانية أو الإنجليزية، لكنني الآن أستطيع الكتابة بكلتا اللغتين. في سن الخامسة، لم أكن أستطيع استخدام الحاسوب، والآن بعد أن أصبحت في السابعة، أستطيع استخدام الحاسوب وجهاز آيفون. عندما كنت صغيراً، لم أكن أستطيع لعب كرة القدم، لكنني الآن أستطيع تسجيل الكثير من الأهداف. في الصف الثاني، لم أكن أستطيع السباحة جيداً، لكنني الآن أستطيع السباحة لمسافات طويلة.

title: Little Miss Picasso
content: Alexandra Nechita is thirteen and she is called 'the new Picasso'. She paints large pictures in cubist style and sells them for between $10,000 and $80,000. She was born in Romania but now she lives in Los Angeles with her family. She could paint very well when she was only four, but her parents couldn't understand her pictures. Alexandra says: 'I paint how I feel. Sometimes I'm happy and sometimes sad, I can't stop painting'. Every day after school she does her homework, plays with her little brother, then paints for two or three hours until bedtime. Alexandra doesn't spend her money, she saves it: 'We were very poor when we were first in America. We couldn't buy many things, but now I can buy a big house for my family and we can travel the world. Last year we were in London, Paris, and Rome. It was fantastic!'
translation_ar: ألكسندرا نيتشيتا تبلغ من العمر ثلاثة عشر عامًا ويُطلق عليها اسم «بيكاسو الجديدة». ترسم لوحات كبيرة بأسلوب التكعيبية وتبيعها بما يتراوح بين 10,000 و80,000 دولار. وُلدت في رومانيا لكنها تعيش الآن في لوس أنجلوس مع عائلتها. كانت تستطيع الرسم بشكل جيد جدًا عندما كان عمرها أربع سنوات فقط، لكن والديها لم يكونا يفهمان لوحاتها. تقول ألكسندرا: «أنا أرسم ما أشعر به. أحيانًا أكون سعيدة وأحيانًا حزينة، ولا أستطيع التوقف عن الرسم». كل يوم بعد المدرسة تؤدي واجباتها المنزلية، وتلعب مع أخيها الصغير، ثم ترسم لمدة ساعتين أو ثلاث ساعات حتى موعد النوم. لا تنفق ألكسندرا أموالها، بل تدخرها: «كنا فقراء جدًا عندما وصلنا إلى أمريكا لأول مرة. لم نكن نستطيع شراء أشياء كثيرة، لكنني الآن أستطيع شراء منزل كبير لعائلتي ويمكننا السفر حول العالم. في العام الماضي كنا في لندن وباريس وروما. كان ذلك رائعًا!»

title: Modern Communication
content: Nowadays, life has changed completely. New inventions and discoveries have made life easier but more stressful at the same time. For example, the internet and the cellphone have invaded all aspects of our life; they are everywhere, at home, in the office, at school. Due to the internet and mobiles, communication technology is bringing people closer together. Family members are keeping in regular contact now more than ever before. And this is all done through email, chat, cellphones and SMS messaging. Years ago, it took a long time to write a letter, then find an envelope and go to the post office to buy a stamp and post it. Today, we write mails which are sent in an instant. Having free internet telephone calls also helps us to stay in touch more often and for a longer period of time.
translation_ar: في الوقت الحاضر، تغيرت الحياة بشكل كامل. جعلت الاختراعات والاكتشافات الجديدة الحياة أسهل ولكنها أكثر توترًا في الوقت نفسه. فعلى سبيل المثال، غزا الإنترنت والهاتف المحمول جميع جوانب حياتنا؛ فهما موجودان في كل مكان، في المنزل والمكتب والمدرسة. وبفضل الإنترنت والهواتف المحمولة، تعمل تكنولوجيا الاتصال على تقريب الناس من بعضهم البعض. ويحافظ أفراد العائلة على اتصال منتظم الآن أكثر من أي وقت مضى. ويتم ذلك كله من خلال البريد الإلكتروني والدردشة والهواتف المحمولة والرسائل النصية القصيرة. في الماضي، كان يستغرق الأمر وقتًا طويلًا لكتابة رسالة، ثم العثور على ظرف والذهاب إلى مكتب البريد لشراء طابع وإرسالها. أما اليوم، فنكتب رسائل إلكترونية تُرسل في لحظة. كما تساعدنا المكالمات الهاتفية المجانية عبر الإنترنت على البقاء على اتصال بشكل أكثر تكرارًا ولمدة أطول.

title: Life on a Farm
content: I always think of the time when I used to live on a farm and in winter especially we were cut off from the outside world. Life used to be very simple for me. I used to go to the nearest school. Father used to work in the fields and mother used to help him. She worked indoors and outdoors. I used to collect wood and feed the domestic animals and my sisters used to fetch water and help in the house chores. There didn't use to be many free time activities. We used to listen to the radio and in the evening, all the family used to sit by the fire in a big room where we told tales or discussed. In summer, we didn't use to have a refrigerator; we used to drink fresh and tasty water from the pottery jars made of clay. My grandma used to make and decorate them. And we used to eat fresh vegetables that father grew. Now, I am in the city. I live in a small flat. I buy food from the supermarket. The streets seem to be smaller because of the traffic and the air is polluted. I get stressed and I dream of the time when I will be on holidays to be able to leave home and escape to the countryside.
translation_ar: أتذكر دائمًا الوقت الذي كنت أعيش فيه في مزرعة، وخاصة في فصل الشتاء عندما كنا معزولين عن العالم الخارجي. كانت الحياة بسيطة جدًا بالنسبة لي. كنت أذهب إلى أقرب مدرسة. كان والدي يعمل في الحقول وكانت أمي تساعده. كانت تعمل داخل المنزل وخارجه. كنت أجمع الحطب وأطعم الحيوانات المنزلية، وكانت أخواتي يجلبن الماء ويساعدن في الأعمال المنزلية. لم تكن هناك أنشطة كثيرة لوقت الفراغ. كنا نستمع إلى الراديو، وفي المساء كانت العائلة كلها تجلس بجانب النار في غرفة كبيرة حيث نحكي القصص أو نتحدث. في الصيف، لم يكن لدينا ثلاجة؛ كنا نشرب الماء الطازج واللذيذ من الجرار الفخارية المصنوعة من الطين. كانت جدتي تصنعها وتزينها. وكنا نأكل الخضروات الطازجة التي يزرعها والدي. الآن أنا في المدينة. أعيش في شقة صغيرة. أشتري الطعام من السوق. تبدو الشوارع أصغر بسبب حركة المرور والهواء ملوث. أشعر بالتوتر وأحلم بالوقت الذي سأكون فيه في عطلة لأتمكن من مغادرة المنزل والهروب إلى الريف.

title: I Was Only Trying to Help!
content: Alex always enjoys the drive to Leeds because it is a good and straight road with pleasant views of the countryside on the two sides. In addition, there is rarely much traffic along the way. Last week Alex was rather unhappy and annoyed. She was driving the car when a small blue car came very close behind her. She went faster, hoping to leave the car behind. However, when she slowed down, the car caught up with her. The driver, a middle-aged man, was grinning and waving to her, but she didn't recognize him or the car. Again she started to drive very fast, but the little car caught up with her whenever she slowed down. She thought there was something wrong, so she checked the lights and the indicator, but everything was in order. Alex was driving very fast while the man in the blue car was trying to catch her. He was calling and waving his hands when she drove off very fast, leaving him far away behind. Alex didn't slow down until she got to Leeds. There are some traffic lights just before you cross the railway bridge into Leeds. As it happened, the lights turned red as she approached. She was still waiting there when the little blue car caught up with her. The driver got out and tapped on her window. She opened it and asked him coldly if she could offer help. The man told her about the number plate of her car that had fallen off about fifteen miles back. He was trying to attract her attention, but she didn't take any notice.
translation_ar: كانت أليكس تستمتع دائمًا بالقيادة إلى ليدز لأن الطريق جيد ومستقيم، وتوجد مناظر جميلة للريف على جانبيه. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، نادرًا ما تكون هناك حركة مرور كثيرة في الطريق. في الأسبوع الماضي كانت أليكس غير سعيدة ومنزعجة نوعًا ما. كانت تقود السيارة عندما اقتربت منها سيارة زرقاء صغيرة جدًا من الخلف. زادت سرعتها، على أمل أن تترك السيارة خلفها. لكن عندما خففت سرعتها، لحقت بها السيارة. كان السائق رجلًا في منتصف العمر، يبتسم ويلوح لها، لكنها لم تتعرف عليه ولا على السيارة. بدأت مرة أخرى تقود بسرعة كبيرة، لكن السيارة الصغيرة كانت تلحق بها كلما خففت سرعتها. اعتقدت أن هناك شيئًا خاطئًا، فتحققت من الأضواء وإشارة الانعطاف، لكن كل شيء كان على ما يرام. كانت أليكس تقود بسرعة كبيرة بينما كان الرجل في السيارة الزرقاء يحاول اللحاق بها. كان يناديها ويلوح بيديه عندما انطلقت بسرعة، تاركة إياه بعيدًا خلفها. لم تخفف أليكس سرعتها حتى وصلت إلى ليدز. توجد إشارات مرور قبل عبور جسر السكة الحديد إلى ليدز. وبالصدفة، تحولت الإشارة إلى اللون الأحمر عندما اقتربت. وبينما كانت لا تزال تنتظر، لحقت بها السيارة الزرقاء الصغيرة. نزل السائق وطرق على نافذتها. فتحتها وسألته ببرود إن كان بإمكانها مساعدته. أخبرها الرجل أن لوحة أرقام سيارتها سقطت قبل حوالي خمسة عشر ميلًا. كان يحاول لفت انتباهها، لكنها لم تنتبه إليه.

title: My Future Job
content: Mother: After a long period of study, you are finally in 4Ms and you will take your Brevet exam in a few months. Now, you know many things about your country and the world around you. You will have to make important choices. Some students will look for a job, others will keep studying. You will have to decide what to do in the future. What about you, son? Son: Well mum. You know that I love animals. And in the future I want to be a vet. If I pass my Brevet exam, I'll study at secondary school. I'll work hard for three years. I will opt for science stream. As soon as I pass my baccalaureate, I'll do veterinary science at the university. After I get my diploma, I'll be a vet in a zoo. I'll travel all over the world to see wild animals and animals in danger of extinction. I'll do my best to protect them. Mother: You know you are important to your family and your community. You must realize that your attitude will build your future and the future starts today. May God realize all your dreams.
translation_ar: الأم: بعد فترة طويلة من الدراسة، أنت الآن في السنة الرابعة متوسط وستجتاز امتحان شهادة التعليم المتوسط بعد بضعة أشهر. أنت تعرف الآن أشياء كثيرة عن بلدك والعالم من حولك. سيكون عليك اتخاذ قرارات مهمة. بعض التلاميذ سيبحثون عن عمل، بينما سيواصل آخرون الدراسة. سيكون عليك أن تقرر ماذا ستفعل في المستقبل. ماذا عنك يا بني؟ الابن: حسنًا يا أمي. أنت تعلمين أنني أحب الحيوانات. وفي المستقبل أريد أن أصبح طبيبًا بيطريًا. إذا نجحت في امتحان شهادة التعليم المتوسط، فسأدرس في الثانوية. سأعمل بجد لمدة ثلاث سنوات. سأختار شعبة العلوم. وبمجرد أن أنجح في شهادة البكالوريا، سأدرس العلوم البيطرية في الجامعة. وبعد حصولي على شهادتي، سأعمل طبيبًا بيطريًا في حديقة حيوانات. سأسافر حول العالم لأرى الحيوانات البرية والحيوانات المهددة بالانقراض. وسأبذل قصارى جهدي لحمايتها. الأم: أنت مهم لعائلتك ومجتمعك. يجب أن تدرك أن موقفك سيبني مستقبلك، والمستقبل يبدأ اليوم. أتمنى أن يحقق الله جميع أحلامك.

title: My Likes and Dislikes
content: I am Linda and I am 16 years old. I am from Ireland. Today I am writing to tell you about the things that I like and things that I don't like. It is not easy because there are too many things. That's why I am going to write about three or four topics. I really like listening to music. I like different types of music but I am crazy for electronic music. My favorite DJ is Calvin Harris. I also like watching TV and movies. I like drama movies and sitcoms. I like going out with my school friends. We sometimes go to the movie theatre and the mall. Let's talk about food and drinks. I don't like fish very much, but I like meat. I also like white coffee. When it comes to fruit, I really adore grapes but pears are not my cup of tea. I like apples and I love oranges! I'm not a fan of vegetables, but my parents and teachers say they're very important. I think they're right. I really hate broccoli, but carrots are OK. I detest cucumber salad, but I like mixed salad. I'm crazy for mushrooms, but I really don't like onions. At school, I don't like History very much and I hate Maths lessons! Anyway, I like Gym and Art, but I prefer Science because I'm crazy for animals. I really like Painting and I love Portuguese lessons, but my favorite subject is English, of course!

title: My Friend Stephanie
content: This is a photo of my friend, Stephanie. She is 15 and she is French. She lives in a village near Toulouse. She studies at Francois College. She has short black hair and very dark eyes. She is intelligent and cool, but sometimes she is a bit sad too. She loves music and she likes writing songs. She can play the guitar very well and she has a beautiful voice. We love listening to her. She has had an amazing experience; she has already sung in Karaoke with our friends. But she has never participated in an official music contest. I hope she'll do it someday. She's also crazy about computers, and she likes looking for lyrics on the internet. She only hates one thing: doing sport.

title: My Future Career
content: Hello, Salima! Thank you for asking me about my future job. Well, when I was a child I dreamt of being a photographer because I used to like taking photos of friends and editing them. Then everything has changed since I visited a hospital for cancer patients at the Oncology Hospital in my city. From that point, I decided to become a doctor to help people and do something good for my country. As for now, I am focusing my attention on finishing my studies at secondary school. Soon I will take the first important exam of my life - the baccalaureat exam. I won't stop working hard until I pass. As you know, I'm good at English, Maths, biology and physics. So, if I get it with distinction, I'll study at the Medical University and my dreams may come true. I will seek more information about that from professors and career counselors at my school who are very supportive and helpful. It is very hard to choose a career before you complete high school, but always keep in mind that it is never too late to change your path and no one says you have to decide now. Everyone would like to be good at what they choose.
translation_ar: مرحبًا سلمى! شكرًا لسؤالك عن وظيفتي المستقبلية. عندما كنت طفلة، كنت أحلم بأن أصبح مصورة لأنني كنت أحب التقاط صور أصدقائي وتعديلها. ثم تغير كل شيء منذ أن زرت مستشفى لمرضى السرطان في مستشفى الأورام في مدينتي. ومنذ ذلك الوقت، قررت أن أصبح طبيبة لمساعدة الناس والقيام بشيء جيد من أجل بلدي. أما الآن، فأنا أركز اهتمامي على إكمال دراستي في الثانوية. قريبًا سأجتاز أول امتحان مهم في حياتي، وهو امتحان البكالوريا. لن أتوقف عن العمل الجاد حتى أنجح. كما تعلمون، أنا جيدة في الإنجليزية والرياضيات وعلم الأحياء والفيزياء. لذلك، إذا حصلت على البكالوريا بتقدير ممتاز، فسأدرس في كلية الطب وقد تتحقق أحلامي. سأبحث عن مزيد من المعلومات حول ذلك من الأساتذة ومستشاري التوجيه المهني في مدرستي، فهم داعمون ومساعدون جدًا. من الصعب جدًا اختيار مهنة قبل إكمال المرحلة الثانوية، لكن تذكر دائمًا أنه لم يفت الأوان أبدًا لتغيير طريقك، ولا أحد يقول إن عليك أن تقرر الآن. الجميع يرغب في أن يكون جيدًا في المجال الذي يختاره.

title: Riyad Mahrez
content: Riyad Karim Mahrez was born on 21 February 1991. He is a small and slim professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Manchester City and the Algerian national team. Mahrez began his career as a youth player for French club AAS Sarcelles. In January 2014, Mahrez signed for English side Leicester City. He helped them win the Championship and promotion to the Premier League at the end of his first season. In the 2015-16 season he was the Algerian Footballer of the Year, but he remained modest, helpful and a fair game player. In January 2016, Mahrez's transfer value was said to have risen from £4.5 million to £30.1 million, ranking him among the top 50 most valuable players in Europe. When Leicester finished the season as champions, Mahrez became the first Algerian to win a Premier League medal. On 10 July 2018, Manchester City confirmed his signing and the transfer fee of £60m made Mahrez the most expensive African footballer.
translation_ar: وُلد رياض كريم محرز في 21 فبراير 1991. وهو لاعب كرة قدم محترف قصير ونحيف يلعب كجناح لنادي مانشستر سيتي في الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز وللمنتخب الجزائري. بدأ محرز مسيرته كلاعب شاب في النادي الفرنسي آ.أ.س سارسيلي. في يناير 2014، وقع محرز مع نادي ليستر سيتي الإنجليزي. وساعدهم على الفوز ببطولة الدرجة الأولى والصعود إلى الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز في نهاية موسمه الأول. في موسم 2015-2016، حصل على لقب أفضل لاعب كرة قدم جزائري، لكنه بقي متواضعًا ومساعدًا ولاعبًا عادلًا. في يناير 2016، قيل إن قيمة انتقال محرز ارتفعت من 4.5 مليون جنيه إسترليني إلى 30.1 مليون جنيه إسترليني، مما جعله من بين أغلى 50 لاعبًا في أوروبا. وعندما أنهى ليستر الموسم بطلًا، أصبح محرز أول جزائري يفوز بميدالية الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز. وفي 10 يوليو 2018، أكد مانشستر سيتي تعاقده معه، وجعلت قيمة الصفقة البالغة 60 مليون جنيه إسترليني محرز أغلى لاعب كرة قدم أفريقي.

title: Planning for the Future
content: It's never too early to start thinking about your future and what you want to do. When you're young, you may think you have all the time to make important choices which affect your future. But you must decide about your education, work experience and career to make your life easier by planning for the future you really want. Everyone dreams about an interesting and satisfactory job with good salary, lovely family, beautiful house and a fashionable car. So, how will you make that? To be a successful person, you need to determine your future plans and work hard to achieve your dreams. Success depends really on the pupil's efforts. If you think about it, explore questions about the future you want, stop thinking of the past and focus on your prospects and goals, you will find your passion and you will start feeling proud of what you're good at. You are now middle school learners. Start by working to succeed in the B.E.M exams and make it possible for you to put the first step in your future life. So, trust yourself and make efforts to be a good citizen.

title: Bill and Simone's Holiday
content:
I still remember that disastrous sailing holiday.

Bill and I left Miami one summer weekend on a sailing holiday in our boat "Siboney". We wanted to sail round the Caribbean Sea for a couple of weeks.

During our holiday, we saw a large group of whales. We were very excited. Unfortunately, while we were watching them, the whales began to hit the side of our boat. Suddenly, water started flooding in and we realized that we were in trouble. We quickly jumped into the lifeboat while the boat was sinking. Soon, it disappeared under the sea.

Fortunately, we had enough food and water for twenty days and a fishing line which helped us to survive. For the next fifty days, we caught about ten fish a day and ate them raw. We also drank only rain water. We saw many boats but although we waved and shouted while they were passing, nobody saw us. Then, as we were beginning to lose hope, a fishing boat rescued us. Our disastrous holiday was over.
translation_ar:
ما زلت أتذكر تلك العطلة الكارثية في الإبحار.

غادرنا بيل وأنا ميامي في عطلة نهاية أسبوع صيفية لقضاء عطلة في الإبحار على متن قاربنا «سيبوني». كنا نريد الإبحار حول البحر الكاريبي لبضعة أسابيع.

خلال عطلتنا، رأينا مجموعة كبيرة من الحيتان. كنا متحمسين جدًا. لكن لسوء الحظ، بينما كنا نشاهدها، بدأت الحيتان تضرب جانب قاربنا. وفجأة، بدأ الماء يتسرب إلى الداخل وأدركنا أننا في خطر. قفزنا بسرعة إلى قارب النجاة بينما كان قاربنا يغرق. وسرعان ما اختفى تحت البحر.

ولحسن الحظ، كان لدينا ما يكفي من الطعام والماء لمدة عشرين يومًا، وكان لدينا خيط للصيد ساعدنا على البقاء. وخلال الخمسين يومًا التالية، كنا نصطاد حوالي عشر سمكات يوميًا ونأكلها نيئة. كما كنا نشرب مياه الأمطار فقط. رأينا العديد من القوارب، لكن رغم أننا كنا نلوح ونصرخ أثناء مرورها، لم يرنا أحد. ثم، عندما بدأنا نفقد الأمل، أنقذنا قارب صيد. وانتهت عطلتنا الكارثية.

title: My Dream
content:
What do you dream of? You may say it's too private but I'd like to tell you about my dream. My name is Sarah. I am 16. And I live in a small town. I live with my mother. So we don't have enough money to travel. And my mum worries about me so much that it's impossible to imagine us apart. You think I complain but I don't. I like to know that there is somebody who cares for me every minute. And I can dream.

My dream is to go somewhere abroad where people speak English. You know I am pretty good at English. I can communicate in English. I have some friends from abroad and we can talk on the Internet. They tell me about their countries, customs and traditions. I hope my future profession will be connected with travelling, something like an interpreter or stewardess. And I will see all those wonderful things I am told about. That's why I do my best to study English. It's an international language and every modern educated man must know it. Have you ever watched the documentary "Secret"? The main idea of this film is that people's thoughts are material. If you really want something it will come true. That's why every night before going to bed I close my eyes and dream of visiting new places and meeting new people.
translation_ar:
بماذا تحلم؟ قد تقول إن هذا أمر خاص جدًا، لكنني أود أن أخبرك عن حلمي. اسمي سارة، عمري 16 سنة، وأعيش في بلدة صغيرة مع والدتي. ليس لدينا ما يكفي من المال للسفر. وأمي تقلق عليّ كثيرًا لدرجة أنه من المستحيل أن نتخيل أنفسنا بعيدتين عن بعضنا. قد تظن أنني أشكو، لكنني لا أفعل. أحب أن أعرف أن هناك شخصًا يهتم بي في كل دقيقة. ويمكنني أن أحلم.

حلمي هو أن أذهب إلى بلد أجنبي يتحدث سكانه الإنجليزية. كما تعلم، أنا جيدة جدًا في اللغة الإنجليزية. أستطيع التواصل بها. لدي بعض الأصدقاء من الخارج ونتحدث عبر الإنترنت. يخبرونني عن بلدانهم وعاداتهم وتقاليدهم. آمل أن تكون مهنتي المستقبلية مرتبطة بالسفر، مثل مترجمة أو مضيفة طيران. وسأرى كل تلك الأشياء الرائعة التي يخبرونني عنها. لهذا السبب أبذل قصارى جهدي لدراسة الإنجليزية. إنها لغة عالمية، وكل شخص متعلم في العصر الحديث يجب أن يعرفها. هل شاهدت من قبل الفيلم الوثائقي «Secret»؟ الفكرة الرئيسية للفيلم هي أن أفكار الناس يمكن أن تتحول إلى حقيقة. إذا كنت تريد شيئًا حقًا فسوف يتحقق. لذلك، كل ليلة قبل أن أذهب إلى النوم، أغمض عيني وأحلم بزيارة أماكن جديدة ولقاء أشخاص جدد.

title: New Millennium - New Food
content:
Twenty years ago, the UK wasn't famous for good food. In fact, most people laughed at British cooking. When people talk about traditional British food, they always think fish and chips and a cup of tea.

Tea wasn't always a British drink. The Chinese discovered tea nearly 5000 years ago, but it didn't become popular in Europe until the 17th century.

After water, tea is the most popular drink in the world. Tea is very good for you and the Chinese say that it helps people to stay young.

Fish and chips shops became famous among poor people in the UK in the 19th century. Poor people worked very long hours and they didn't have much free time for cooking. Fish and chips were cheap, but they weren't healthy. The shops fried fish and chips in the lard (the fat from cows). Eating a lot of oil is bad but lard is much worse.
translation_ar:
قبل عشرين عامًا، لم تكن المملكة المتحدة مشهورة بالطعام الجيد. في الواقع، كان معظم الناس يسخرون من الطبخ البريطاني. عندما يتحدث الناس عن الطعام البريطاني التقليدي، فإنهم يفكرون دائمًا في السمك والبطاطا المقلية وكوب من الشاي.

لم يكن الشاي دائمًا مشروبًا بريطانيًا. اكتشف الصينيون الشاي منذ ما يقارب 5000 سنة، لكنه لم يصبح شائعًا في أوروبا حتى القرن السابع عشر.

بعد الماء، يعد الشاي أكثر مشروب شعبية في العالم. الشاي مفيد جدًا للصحة، ويقول الصينيون إنه يساعد الناس على البقاء شبابًا.

أصبحت محلات السمك والبطاطا المقلية مشهورة بين الفقراء في المملكة المتحدة في القرن التاسع عشر. كان الفقراء يعملون لساعات طويلة جدًا ولم يكن لديهم الكثير من وقت الفراغ للطبخ. كان السمك والبطاطا المقلية رخيصين، لكنهما لم يكونا صحيين. كانت المحلات تقلي السمك والبطاطا في الشحم، وهو دهن الأبقار. إن تناول الكثير من الزيت أمر سيئ، لكن الشحم أسوأ بكثير.

title: My Dear Mother
content:
My dear mother is Ouahiba. She turned 45 last month but she doesn't look like it. She is very slim and she has medium height with quite long straight black hair and wide shiny green eyes. Her skin is soft and pale. She has a beautiful smile that makes people feel comfortable.

My mom is a very kind, lovely, friendly and patient person. She also loves helping people. She always takes care of her family. She likes her house to be clean and organized. She loves watching Turkish TV series and gardening. In her free time, she enjoys sewing. Sometimes she makes nice pyjamas for us but she hates mess. In her early twenties, she participated in the college's music club and sang folk songs. She was writing poems too. She won her bachelor degree in 1985. Then, she worked as a teacher in the kindergarten school for 25 years.

How can I not love my mom when she carried me 9 months in her womb, then in her arms and forever in her heart? She was supporting me and providing help.

Thank you mommy for being my first fan and my best friend. Thank you for always wiping my tears and teaching me that everything happens for a reason. Thank you for always putting my needs before yours. Thank you for making me the woman I am today.

title: Naguib Mahfouz
content:
Nadjib Mahfudh, spelled also Naguib Mahfouz, is an Egyptian and Arabian outstanding figure in modern literature. He is regarded as one of the first contemporary writers along with Taha Hussein.

He was born on December 11, 1911 in Cairo, Egypt. He is an Egyptian novelist and screenplay writer who was awarded the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1988, the first Arabic writer to be so honored.

Mahfouz grew up in Cairo. He attended the Egyptian University, now Cairo University, where he received a degree in philosophy in 1934. He worked in the Egyptian civil service from 1934 until his retirement in 1971.

Mahfouz's earliest published works were short stories about ancient Egypt. But he turned to describing modern Egyptian society by the time he began his famous work "Al-Thulathiah", also known as "Cairo Trilogy", which consisted of three novels: Bayn Al-Qasrayn (1956; Palace Walk), Qasr Al-Shawq (1957; Palace of Desire), and Al-Sukkariah (1957; Sugar Street).

Mahfouz wrote more than 45 novels and short-story collections in Arabic, as well as 30 plays, and the majority of them were watched on television or acted on the theatre stage. His Nobel Prize for Literature is considered an honor to all Arab writers. Naguib Mahfouz died on August 30, 2006 in Cairo.

كتب محفوظ أكثر من 45 رواية ومجموعة قصصية باللغة العربية، بالإضافة إلى 30 مسرحية، وقد عُرضت معظم أعماله على التلفزيون أو على خشبة المسرح. وتُعتبر جائزة نوبل في الأدب التي حصل عليها تكريمًا لجميع الكتاب العرب. توفي نجيب محفوظ في 30 أغسطس 2006 في القاهرة.

title: Mouloud Feraoun
content:
Mouloud Feraoun is an Algerian novelist and teacher whose works give vivid and warm portraits of Berber life and values.

Feraoun, the son of a peasant farmer, passed his youth in the Great Kabylie mountains. His early successes at school led to a teaching degree from Ecole Normale at Bouzareah. He supported the cause for Algerian independence.

His works all describe Kabyle peasant life. "Le Fils du Pauvre" (1950; "The Poor Man's Son") is a semi-autobiographical story of a Berber youth struggling against poverty and hardship to achieve an education and self-advancement. The portrayal of the simple life in the mountains is filled with nobility, human compassion, love of family and native soil.

"La Terre et le Sang" (1933; "The Earth and Blood") deals with an émigré whose life in France is burdened by the sequestration of his proud countrymen and with the importance of honour, the basis of all traditional morality and the source of the sense of self-worth, dignity, pride and community.

"Les Chemins qui montent" (1957; "The Upward Roads") carries forward in more bitter tones the themes of resignation, resistance and endurance of the fellah (peasant) faced with the realities of colonial society.

Feraoun's devotion to Kabyle culture is also evident in a collection of portraits and sketches, in a translation of 19th-century Kabyle poetry, and in his journal. Some of his books, written in French, have been translated into several languages including English and German.
translation_ar:
مولود فرعون روائي ومعلم جزائري، تقدم أعماله صورًا حية ودافئة لحياة الأمازيغ وقيمهم.

كان فرعون ابن فلاح، وقضى شبابه في جبال القبائل الكبرى. وقد قاد نجاحه المبكر في المدرسة إلى الحصول على شهادة في التعليم من المدرسة العليا ببوزريعة. وكان يدعم قضية استقلال الجزائر.

تصف أعماله كلها حياة الفلاحين القبائل. وتُعد رواية «ابن الفقير» (1950) قصة شبه سيرة ذاتية لشاب أمازيغي يكافح الفقر والمشقة من أجل الحصول على التعليم وتحسين حياته. ويتميز تصوير الحياة البسيطة في الجبال بالنبل والتعاطف الإنساني وحب الأسرة والوطن.

وتتناول رواية «الأرض والدم» (1933) حياة مهاجر في فرنسا، وتتناول أيضًا أهمية الشرف، الذي يمثل أساس الأخلاق التقليدية ومصدر الشعور بقيمة الذات والكرامة والفخر والمجتمع.

أما «الطريق الصاعد» (1957) فتواصل، بنبرة أكثر مرارة، موضوعات الاستسلام والمقاومة والصمود التي يعيشها الفلاح أمام واقع المجتمع الاستعماري.

ويتجلى تفاني فرعون في الثقافة القبائلية أيضًا في مجموعة من الصور والرسومات، وفي ترجمة الشعر القبائلي من القرن التاسع عشر، وفي مذكراته. وقد تُرجمت بعض كتبه المكتوبة بالفرنسية إلى عدة لغات، منها الإنجليزية والألمانية.

title: Father of Algerian Nationalism
content:
Ahmed Messali Hadj was an Algerian nationalist political leader. This famous leader was born on May 16, 1898 in Tlemcen, where he grew up, learnt the Holy Quran and received a religious education influenced by the Darqawiyya Sufi order. He was also educated in a local French primary school.

Later, he founded the ENA, "North African Star" (1926-1937), the PPA, "Algerian People's Party" (1937-1939), and the MTLD, "Movement for the Triumph of Democratic Liberties" (1946-1954), before dissociating himself from the armed struggle for independence in 1954.

He also founded the MNA, "Algerian National Movement" (1954), to counteract the ongoing efforts of the FLN, "National Liberation Front" (1954). He defended his land and protected the Algerian values, language and religion to keep the Algerians unified against their enemy.

Consequently, he became one of the most prominent Algerian nationalists seeking to remove all French forces and to end French colonial rule in Algeria. He died on June 3, 1974 in Paris, France.

لاحقًا، أسس نجم شمال إفريقيا (1926-1937)، وحزب الشعب الجزائري (1937-1939)، وحركة انتصار الحريات الديمقراطية (1946-1954)، قبل أن ينفصل عن الكفاح المسلح من أجل الاستقلال عام 1954.

كما أسس الحركة الوطنية الجزائرية عام 1954 لمواجهة جهود جبهة التحرير الوطني. ودافع عن أرضه وحافظ على القيم واللغة والدين الجزائري من أجل إبقاء الجزائريين متحدين ضد عدوهم.

وبالتالي، أصبح أحد أبرز الوطنيين الجزائريين الذين سعوا إلى طرد القوات الفرنسية وإنهاء الحكم الاستعماري الفرنسي في الجزائر. توفي في 3 يونيو 1974 في باريس، فرنسا.

title: My Memorable Trip to India
title_ar: رحلتي التي لا تنسى إلى الهند
content:
We have returned from a stunning trip to India. My experience was wonderful. You can say that India is a combination of different countries: hundreds of interesting people, fascinating monuments, and delicious food.

I want to share every moment. First, our trip began in New Delhi, which is known as the heart of India. We visited all the popular tourist sites: Red Fort, Lotus Temple, etc. Then, we moved to Jodhpur. After that, we reached Jaipur, and we spent two nights there. We went for an elephant ride at the fort. It was exciting; the fort was beautiful, and the museum was also worth visiting.

Finally, we arrived at Agra, where we saw the famous landmark "The Taj Mahal" at the time of sunrise. It was a treat to watch. It attracts 7-8 million visitors a year. I think that any tourist who visits India for the first time has to watch the Taj Mahal, which was commissioned in 1632 by Shah Jahan to house the tomb of his wife, Mumtaz Mahal. It is 73m tall, and it has an area of 17 hectares. It was completed in 1653. It was designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1983 for being the Jewel of Muslim Art in India and one of the admired masterpieces of the world's heritage. This fascinating monument was designed by the architect Ustad Ahmad Lahauri.

I wish that India will become the most famous tourist destination in the world.

أريد أن أشارككم كل لحظة. بدأت رحلتنا أولًا في نيودلهي، المعروفة باسم قلب الهند. زرنا جميع المواقع السياحية الشهيرة، مثل القلعة الحمراء ومعبد اللوتس وغيرها. ثم انتقلنا إلى جودبور. وبعد ذلك وصلنا إلى جايبور وقضينا ليلتين هناك. ذهبنا في جولة على ظهر فيل عند القلعة. كان الأمر ممتعًا؛ كانت القلعة جميلة، وكان المتحف يستحق الزيارة أيضًا.

وأخيرًا وصلنا إلى أغرا، حيث شاهدنا المعلم الشهير «تاج محل» وقت شروق الشمس. كان مشهدًا رائعًا. ويستقبل تاج محل من 7 إلى 8 ملايين زائر سنويًا. أعتقد أن أي سائح يزور الهند لأول مرة يجب أن يشاهد تاج محل، الذي أمر ببنائه شاه جهان عام 1632 ليضم ضريح زوجته ممتاز محل. يبلغ ارتفاعه 73 مترًا وتبلغ مساحته 17 هكتارًا. اكتمل بناؤه عام 1653. وأُدرج ضمن مواقع التراث العالمي لليونسكو عام 1983 باعتباره جوهرة الفن الإسلامي في الهند وأحد أكثر روائع التراث العالمي إعجابًا. وقد صمم هذا المعلم الرائع المهندس المعماري أوستاد أحمد لاهوري.

أتمنى أن تصبح الهند أشهر وجهة سياحية في العالم.

title: The Algerian Hero
content:
Abdelkader Ibn Mahieddine, known as El Amir Abdelkader, was an Algerian religious man and a military leader. This great hero was born in 1807, in Mascara, where he grew up and learnt the Quran as well as other subjects.

El Amir was a political leader and a brave warrior. He successfully faced the French army and saved the Christian community of Damascus from massacre in 1860. So this intervention, which is now called human rights, brought him admiration and awards from around the whole world.

This hero won many battles against the French army. Among his famous battles were the Battle of Maktaa, the Battle of Sig and the Battle of Sidi Brahim. The French army feared El Amir because they were attacked unexpectedly by his army. He defended his land and protected the Algerian values, language and religion to keep the Algerians unified against their enemy. However, El Amir Abdelkader ended up surrendering and was forced to surrender. In 1848, he was transferred with his family and followers to the Chateau d'Amboise.

title: A Day Out in New York City
content:
Hi, Sam!

Did you have a good weekend?

We went to New York City for a day out. It was fun! We left home early and travelled by train to the Big Apple, which was named on February 14th, 1924 by John Fitz Gerald. First, we visited the Museum of Modern Art. It was created by Paul Sachs, Josephine Boardman and others in 1929. The Picasso paintings were so cool! Then we had lunch in a small cafe near the museum. The food was delicious!

After lunch, we walked in Central Park, which was designed by Frederick Law Olmsted. It's enormous! Later, we went to a movie theater near Broadway. It's as attractive as Shakespeare's in London. We watched a movie. It wasn't very good! Finally, we stopped at a fast food place and had a snack. It was a cool place. Then we went home. We were all so tired. What did you do?

Love,

Tom.

title: Taha Husayn
content: Taha Husayn was one of the most influential 20th-century Egyptian writers and intellectuals. He was born on Nov. 4, 1889, in Maghagha, a mill town in Minya Province, Egypt. He became blind at the age of three from a combination of eye disease and folk medicine. After completing studies at the village mosque school, Taha was sent to Cairo in 1902 to attend al-Azhar, the mosque university. Because of his outspoken opposition to the school's teaching system at al-Azhar, Husayn failed in his final examinations. He enrolled in the new, worldly Egyptian University, where he studied with some of the leading scholars of the time, Egyptian and European, in the field of Arabic and Islamic studies. In this new atmosphere, Husayn received the first doctorate awarded by the university in 1914 for his thesis on Abu-l-Ala al-Maarri. Al-Ayyam and the Pre-Islamic Poetry criticism book were among his most famous works. His nickname was "The Dean of Arabic Literature". He was nominated for a Nobel Prize in Literature fourteen times. Taha Husayn died in 1973. He was considered one of Egypt's leading men of letters. He devoted his life to intellectual freedom for the writer, critic, and scholar and to the introduction of Western learning into his country.

title: Mohamed Larbi Ben M’hidi
content: Mohamed Larbi Ben M’hidi, one of the most prominent freedom fighters and martyrs in the history of the Algerian Revolution, was born in 1923 in the village of El Kouahi, Oum El Bouagui, Eastern Algeria. In 1939, he joined the Algerian Muslim Scouts. He was deeply shocked by the Massacre of May 8, 1945. In 1954, he and others decided to declare the Algerian Revolution. He was a brilliant and brave revolutionary leader who succeeded in organizing the Soumam Conference in 1956, but he was captured by the French Army in 1957. Despite all the torture, he kept smiling until he was executed on March 4, 1957, on a farm 18 kilometers south of Algiers. Ben M’hidi was sure that the next Algerian generation would follow the path which he and all the martyrs had paved with their blood.

title: Ernest Miller Hemingway
content: Ernest Miller Hemingway was born on July 21, 1899, in Cicero, now in Oak Park, Illinois, U.S. He was an American novelist and short-story writer. He was educated in a public school and began to write in high school. After his graduation from high school in 1917, he was employed as a reporter at The Star. In the 1920s, he moved to Paris. Six years later, he wrote his first novel, The Sun Also Rises. During his career, Ernest wrote many articles and novels. However, The Old Man and the Sea is his masterpiece, for which he received the Pulitzer Prize for Fiction in 1952 and which played a role in gaining the Nobel Prize in Literature for him in 1954. The Nobel Prize winner shot himself dead in 1960.

title: A Wonderful Trip Around Europe
content: Hello, I am Selma. Last summer I had a wonderful trip with my family. First, we flew from Algiers to Paris on a plane to see the Eiffel Tower, which is a famous monument in France. It is located in Paris and it is 324 meters high. It was built by the architect Gustave Eiffel in 1889. It is fascinating and huge. Then, we wanted to see Big Ben. Therefore, we took a cruise ship and sailed to London. We visited the house of Shakespeare, who is a prominent figure in English literature. He was born on April 23, 1564, in Stratford-upon-Avon, England. William Shakespeare was a writer, poet and playwright. He wrote a famous play called Romeo and Juliet. He died on April 26, 1616. After that, we took a train to Rome, the capital of Italy, to see Roman architecture. We visited the Pisa Tower, which is a wonderful and famous landmark in Italy. Finally, we returned to Algiers and I was very happy because I had a wonderful journey with my family around Europe.

title: Why Do People Travel?
content: Millions of people like travelling. They travel all over different countries, continents, modern and ancient cities. It is always interesting to discover various ways of life, to meet new people and to taste different food. People who live in the countryside often like to go to the city in order to visit museums and art galleries, things they do not have in their villages. But people living in the city prefer to spend their holidays by the sea or in the mountains where they can get away from stressful city life. Many tourists like taking photos of famous sights, like old buildings, castles, mountains, waterfalls and lakes. People choose many means of transport according to their plans and preferences. They travel because they want to see and learn things they can never learn at home or read about in books and newspapers or even see on TV. The best way to learn about other cultures is to travel, discover famous landmarks and meet people in their own hometowns.
translation_ar: يحب الملايين من الناس السفر. يسافرون في مختلف البلدان والقارات والمدن الحديثة والقديمة. ومن الممتع دائمًا اكتشاف أنماط الحياة المختلفة، والتعرف على أشخاص جدد وتذوق أطعمة متنوعة. غالبًا ما يحب الأشخاص الذين يعيشون في الريف الذهاب إلى المدينة لزيارة المتاحف والمعارض الفنية، وهي أشياء لا توجد في قراهم. أما سكان المدن فيفضلون قضاء عطلاتهم بجانب البحر أو في الجبال حيث يمكنهم الابتعاد عن حياة المدينة المليئة بالتوتر. يحب العديد من السياح التقاط صور للمعالم الشهيرة، مثل المباني القديمة والقلاع والجبال والشلالات والبحيرات. ويختار الناس وسائل نقل مختلفة حسب خططهم وتفضيلاتهم. يسافرون لأنهم يريدون رؤية وتعلم أشياء لا يمكنهم تعلمها في المنزل أو قراءتها في الكتب والصحف أو حتى رؤيتها على التلفاز. وأفضل طريقة للتعرف على الثقافات الأخرى هي السفر واكتشاف المعالم الشهيرة والالتقاء بالناس في مدنهم وبلدانهم.

title: Moufdi Zakaria
content: Cheikh Zakaria Ben Slimane Ben Yahia was born on June 12, 1908. He was given the nickname of Moufdi by a school friend. He was born and attended school in the M'zab region of Algeria. He became associated with Algerian nationalists and served time in prison for his beliefs in 1937 and 1938. In 1955, he was imprisoned in Serkadji prison by the French for his politics. There he wrote a poem called Qassaman or The Pledge. It was said that he wrote the poem on the walls of his cell using his own blood because he had neither pencils nor paper to write in prison. The poem was later set to music by Mohamed Triki in 1956 and then by Mohamed Fawzi. The final song was heard in 1957. This poem became the Algerian national anthem shortly after July 5, 1962, when independence was achieved. Zakaria died in 1977 in Tunisia, but his body was buried in Algeria. His university education was in Tunis where he met a number of poets including Aboul-Qacem Echebbi. His first poetry was published in a Tunisian newspaper in 1925. His poetry was believed to be largely influenced by the work of Egyptian poet Ahmed Shawqi. Moufdi Zakaria Airport in Ghardaia, Algeria, is named in his honour. His name was also given to a cultural centre built in 1984.
translation_ar: ولد الشيخ زكريا بن سليمان بن يحيى في 12 يونيو 1908. أطلق عليه أحد أصدقائه في المدرسة لقب مفدي. ولد ودرس في منطقة مزاب بالجزائر. ارتبط بالوطنيين الجزائريين وسُجن بسبب معتقداته عامي 1937 و1938. وفي عام 1955، سجنه الفرنسيون في سجن سركاجي بسبب نشاطه السياسي. وهناك كتب قصيدة بعنوان قسما. وقيل إنه كتب القصيدة على جدران زنزانته بدمه لأنه لم يكن لديه أقلام أو ورق للكتابة في السجن. لُحنت القصيدة لاحقًا من طرف محمد تريكي عام 1956 ثم محمد فوزي. وسُمعت الأغنية النهائية عام 1957. وأصبحت هذه القصيدة النشيد الوطني الجزائري بعد فترة قصيرة من 5 يوليو 1962، عندما تحقق الاستقلال. توفي زكريا عام 1977 في تونس، لكن دُفن جثمانه في الجزائر. تلقى تعليمه الجامعي في تونس، حيث التقى بعدد من الشعراء، من بينهم أبو القاسم الشابي. نُشرت أولى قصائده في صحيفة تونسية عام 1925. وكان يُعتقد أن شعره تأثر بشكل كبير بأعمال الشاعر المصري أحمد شوقي. وقد سُمي مطار مفدي زكريا في غرداية باسمه تكريمًا له، كما أُطلق اسمه على مركز ثقافي بُني عام 1984.

title: A Holiday in Barcelona
content: Hi Helen, How are you? I was on holiday with my family in Barcelona, in Spain. We flew from London to Barcelona airport. We arrived in Spain at five o'clock in the afternoon and took a taxi to the city centre and to our hotel. We went straight out to a restaurant because we were starving. The next day, we got up early and explored the city. We walked up and down La Rambla, which is a really crowded street in central Barcelona. I bought a postcard at one of the shops there. After that, we went to Park Guell. This park was designed by a famous Spanish architect called Gaudi. It is full of colourful sculptures of animals and shapes and it is a really interesting place to walk around. My favourite sculpture was the Lizard at the entrance. It is really cool. Finally, we visited the Sagrada Familia, which is a fantastic building in Barcelona. Gaudi designed this too. He worked on it for forty years but he died before it was finished. You are not allowed to climb the stairs of the tower because it is too dangerous, but there are lifts you can go up and down in. The views are amazing from the top. We really had a great time there. Bye for now.

title: A Day Out in New York City
content: Hi, Sam! Did you have a good weekend? We went to New York City for a day out. It was fun! We left home early and travelled by train to the Big Apple, which was named on February 18th, 1924, by John Fitz Gerald. First, we visited the Museum of Modern Art. We watched a movie. It wasn't very good! Finally, we stopped at a fast food place and had a snack. It was a cool place. Then we went home. We were all so tired. What did you do? Love, Tom.

title: The Hero
content: Abdelkader Ibn Muhieddine, known as El Emir Abdelkader, was an Algerian religious man and a military leader. This great hero was born in 1807, in Guetna near Mascara, where he grew up and learnt the Quran as well as other subjects. El Emir was a political leader and a brave warrior. He successfully faced the French army and saved the Christian community of Damascus from a massacre in 1860. So, this intervention, which is now called human rights, brought him admiration and awards from around the world. This hero won many battles against the French army. Among his most famous battles are the Battle of Maktaa, the Battle of Sig and the Battle of Sidi Brahim. The French army feared El Emir because they were attacked unexpectedly by his army. He defended his land and protected the Algerian values, language and religion to keep the Algerians unified against their enemy. However, El Emir's rebellion ended and he was forced to surrender. In 1848, he was transferred with his family and followers to the Chateau d'Amboise.

title: Childhood School Memories
content:
Hi,

I was born in Liverpool, England. I am so happy to share my childhood school memories with you.
I was at secondary school. My best subject was Maths. I was good at it. I learnt winning and losing graciously from my (PE) Physical Education teacher. I also learnt that I was capable of more than I thought.

My dream was to become a famous pilot. I was not fond of dates and events, so my worst subject as you knew was History. I remember when I was in 09th grade, I got my national exam (GCSEs) General Certificate of Secondary Education exams. Most students at the age of 15-16 used to pass this exam. It was one of my best moments in my life.

My ideal teacher was Mr Brown. My teacher of Maths. He taught me addition, subtraction, division and multiplication. He was always serious, smart, helpful and thoughtful. He used to tell us, "We would climb the mountain together, we can do it." I loved him because he believed in me.

كنت أدرس في المدرسة الثانوية. كانت مادتي المفضلة هي الرياضيات، وكنت جيدًا فيها. تعلمت من أستاذ التربية البدنية كيف أتقبل الفوز والخسارة بروح رياضية. كما تعلمت أنني قادر على تحقيق أكثر مما كنت أعتقد.

كان حلمي أن أصبح طيارًا مشهورًا. لم أكن أحب التواريخ والأحداث، لذلك كانت مادة التاريخ أسوأ مادة بالنسبة لي. أتذكر عندما كنت في الصف التاسع، اجتزت امتحان الشهادة الوطنية GCSE. كان معظم الطلاب الذين تتراوح أعمارهم بين 15 و16 عامًا يجتازون هذا الامتحان. وكانت تلك واحدة من أفضل لحظات حياتي.

كان أستاذي المثالي هو السيد براون، أستاذ الرياضيات. علمني الجمع والطرح والقسمة والضرب. كان دائمًا جادًا وذكيًا ومساعدًا ومهتمًا. وكان يقول لنا: «سنصعد الجبل معًا، ويمكننا فعل ذلك». أحببته لأنه كان يؤمن بقدراتي.

title: The Great Mosque of Algiers
content:
Algeria is set to finally open the Great Mosque of Algiers. It is located in the Al-Mohammadiya area of Algiers and extends to an area of 200,000 square meters. It is the third largest of its kind in the world after the Two Holy Mosques in Saudi Arabia. The Great Mosque was designed and constructed by China State Construction Engineering on August 16th, 2012.

It includes a 20,000 square meter praying hall which can hold a capacity of 120,000 people. It will also have its own library which can host 6,000 people at a time. A Quran school will be part of the mosque with the hope of graduating imams and religion researchers. The mosque's minaret is nearly 265m in height with 43 floors. Each floor has a museum that documents a specific historical era of Islam. There are three floors under the mosque including a car park with a capacity to hold 6,000 vehicles. The mosque's minaret is the tallest building in the world.

title: Father of Algerian Nationalism
content:
Ahmed Messali Hadj was an Algerian nationalist politician leader. This famous leader was born on May 16th, 1898 in Tlemcen, where he grew up, learnt the Holy Quran and received a religious education influenced by the Darqawiyya Sufi order. He was also educated in a local French primary school.

Later, he founded the (ENA) "North African Star" (1926–1937), the (PPA) "Algerian People's Party" (1937–1939), and the (MTLD) "Movement for the Triumph of Democratic Liberties" (1946–1954) before dissociating himself from the armed struggle for Independence in 1954. He also founded the (MNA) "Algerian National Movement" (1954) to counteract the ongoing efforts of the (FLN) "National Liberation Front" (1954).

He defended his land and protected the Algerian values, language and religion to keep the Algerians unified against their enemy. Consequently, he became one of the most prominent Algerian nationalists seeking to remove all French forces and to end French colonial rule in Algeria. He died on June 3rd, 1974 in Paris, France.

لاحقًا، أسس حركة نجم شمال إفريقيا (1926–1937)، وحزب الشعب الجزائري (1937–1939)، وحركة انتصار الحريات الديمقراطية (1946–1954)، قبل أن ينفصل عن الكفاح المسلح من أجل الاستقلال سنة 1954. كما أسس الحركة الوطنية الجزائرية سنة 1954 لمواجهة جهود جبهة التحرير الوطني.

دافع عن أرضه وحمى القيم الجزائرية واللغة والدين من أجل الحفاظ على وحدة الجزائريين ضد عدوهم. ونتيجة لذلك، أصبح أحد أبرز الوطنيين الجزائريين الذين سعوا إلى طرد القوات الفرنسية وإنهاء الاستعمار الفرنسي في الجزائر. توفي في 3 يونيو 1974 في باريس، فرنسا.

title: Hassiba Ben Bouali
content:
Hassiba Ben Bouali was a militant in the Algerian independence war (1954–1962).

She was born on January 18th, 1938 in El Chlef, Algeria. Her parents moved to Algiers in 1947, where she studied at the Lycee Delacroix high school. She joined the Scout Movement, and her travels made her aware of the conditions of the Algerian people under the colonial government. This motivated her to join the Union générale des étudiants musulmans algériens (General Union of Algerian Muslim Students) in 1954, at the age of 16. She participated in the nationalist struggle until her death.

In the 1957 Battle of Algiers, she and three companions, including Ali Ammar (Ali La Pointe), were killed when French forces bombed their hideout on October 9th, 1957 in the Casbah.

Ben Bouali was depicted in the movie The Battle of Algiers by Italian director Gillo Pontecorvo. One of the largest avenues in Algiers and the University of Chlef were named after her.

كانت حسيبة بن بوعلي مناضلة في حرب استقلال الجزائر (1954–1962).

وُلدت في 18 يناير 1938 في الشلف بالجزائر. انتقل والداها إلى الجزائر العاصمة سنة 1947، حيث درست في ثانوية ديلكروا. انضمت إلى الحركة الكشفية، وجعلتها رحلاتها تدرك ظروف الشعب الجزائري في ظل الحكومة الاستعمارية. دفعها ذلك إلى الانضمام إلى الاتحاد العام للطلبة المسلمين الجزائريين سنة 1954، في سن السادسة عشرة. وواصلت مشاركتها في النضال الوطني حتى وفاتها.

خلال معركة الجزائر سنة 1957، قُتلت هي وثلاثة من رفاقها، من بينهم علي عمار المعروف باسم علي لابوانت، عندما قصفت القوات الفرنسية مخبأهم في 9 أكتوبر 1957 في القصبة.

جُسدت شخصية بن بوعلي في فيلم معركة الجزائر للمخرج الإيطالي جيلو بونتيكورفو. وسُميت إحدى أكبر الطرق في الجزائر العاصمة وجامعة الشلف باسمها.

title: Winfrey Success Story
content:
I believe that being successful means reaching our personal, financial and career goals. Success is important because it provides confidence and the ability to reach greater hopes.

One of the most successful stories that affected my entire life is Oprah Winfrey's success story. She is known as a powerful, influential and successful woman. Oprah Winfrey was born on January 29, 1954 in rural Mississippi. Much of her hard youth was spent in poverty. As a child, she used to dress in potato sacks, which made other children laugh at her. She had a troubled and difficult adolescence.

Her success story began when she moved to live with her father and joined the university in Tennessee, USA. She started working as a journalist and presenter on the radio. Her first experience in media was her TV program named "People Are Talking", which brought her a good name and gave her the chance to host other talk shows. It became a highly successful talk show.

Oprah's success secret is her personal qualities. She is self-confident, hardworking, ambitious, caring, honest, modest, unselfish and, above all, intelligent. She is an idol for millions of girls and women worldwide. Oprah is thinking of expanding her business and will keep using the media to change people's lives for the better.

من أكثر قصص النجاح التي أثرت في حياتي قصة نجاح أوبرا وينفري. وهي معروفة بأنها امرأة قوية ومؤثرة وناجحة. وُلدت أوبرا وينفري في 29 يناير 1954 في منطقة ريفية بولاية ميسيسيبي. قضت جزءًا كبيرًا من طفولتها الصعبة في الفقر. عندما كانت طفلة، كانت ترتدي ملابس مصنوعة من أكياس البطاطا، مما جعل الأطفال الآخرين يسخرون منها. كما عاشت فترة مراهقة صعبة ومضطربة.

بدأت قصة نجاحها عندما انتقلت للعيش مع والدها والتحقت بالجامعة في تينيسي بالولايات المتحدة. بدأت العمل كصحفية ومقدمة برامج في الإذاعة. وكانت أول تجربة لها في الإعلام من خلال برنامج تلفزيوني اسمه "People Are Talking"، وقد منحها شهرة جيدة وأتاح لها فرصة تقديم برامج حوارية أخرى. وأصبح برنامجًا ناجحًا جدًا.

يكمن سر نجاح أوبرا في صفاتها الشخصية. فهي واثقة من نفسها، ومجتهدة، وطموحة، ومهتمة بالآخرين، وصادقة، ومتواضعة، وغير أنانية، وفوق كل شيء ذكية. وهي قدوة لملايين الفتيات والنساء حول العالم. وتفكر أوبرا في توسيع أعمالها وستواصل استخدام الإعلام لتغيير حياة الناس نحو الأفضل.

title: Assia Djebar
content:
Assia Djebar was an Algerian writer and filmmaker whose novels, written in French, mostly focus on women and their place in Algerian society. Her original name was Fatma-Zohra Imalhayéne. She is considered one of North Africa's well-known writers.

She was born on June 30th, 1936, in Cherchell, Algeria, a small town near Algiers. Her career as a novelist began in 1957 with the publication of her first novel, La Soif (The Mischief). It was followed by Les Impatients (1958; The Impatient Ones), which similarly dealt with young women within the colonial Algerian bourgeois milieu.

Djebar spent most of the war years outside Algeria, but afterward she taught history at the University of Algiers, was made department head of the French Section at the university, and became a filmmaker.

Djebar moved to the United States in 1995 and taught French literature at Louisiana State University and then at New York University. In 2005, Djebar was elected to the Académie Française. She died on February 6th, 2015, in Paris, France.

وُلدت في 30 يونيو 1936 في شرشال بالجزائر، وهي بلدة صغيرة قرب الجزائر العاصمة. بدأت مسيرتها كروائية سنة 1957 بنشر روايتها الأولى "العطش". وتلتها رواية "القلقون" سنة 1958، التي تناولت أيضًا حياة الشابات في أوساط البرجوازية الجزائرية خلال الحقبة الاستعمارية.

قضت جبار معظم سنوات الحرب خارج الجزائر، وبعد ذلك درّست التاريخ في جامعة الجزائر، وأصبحت رئيسة قسم اللغة الفرنسية في الجامعة، ثم عملت في مجال الإخراج السينمائي.

انتقلت جبار إلى الولايات المتحدة سنة 1995 ودرّست الأدب الفرنسي في جامعة ولاية لويزيانا ثم في جامعة نيويورك. وفي سنة 2005، انتُخبت عضوًا في الأكاديمية الفرنسية. توفيت في 6 فبراير 2015 في باريس، فرنسا.
